  - Todo.create(): assigns non-null TodoId (spec line 186)
  - Todo.create(): emits exactly one TodoCreated event (spec line 187)
  - Todo.create(): raises InvalidTitleError for invalid title (spec line 188)
  - todo.complete(): active→completed transition + event (spec line 191)
  - todo.complete(): idempotent on already-completed, no event (spec line 192)
  - todo.reopen(): completed→active transition + event (spec line 195)
  - todo.reopen(): idempotent on already-active, no event (spec line 196)
  - todo.updateTitle(): updates title, emits TodoTitleUpdated (spec line 199)
  - todo.updateTitle(): raises InvalidTitleError for invalid title (spec line 200)
  - Failure mode: empty title → InvalidTitleError before persistence (spec line 206)
  - Failure mode: whitespace title update → error, original unchanged (spec line 207)
  - Failure mode: complete already-completed → no duplicate event (spec line 208)
  - Failure mode: delete non-existent TodoId → TodoNotFoundError (spec line 209)
The persistence tests incidentally call domain methods but do not assert any

FAILURE 2 — Repository.delete() silently ignores non-existent TodoId:
Spec failure mode (line 209): "Delete a non-existent TodoId →

Implementation (src/todo/persistence/repository.py:127-133): delete() issues
DELETE SQL and commits with no existence check and no exception raised.
Docstring explicitly states "Silent no-op if the row does not exist."
Test test_delete_non_existent_id_does_not_raise (test_repository.py:367-372)
asserts the opposite of the spec requirement.

tasks.name: rest-api-layer
tasks.description: Implement the REST/JSON API defined in interface.spec.md. Create an HTTP application (e.g. FastAPI or similar) with base path /api/todos. Endpoints required: GET /api/todos (with optional ?filter=all|active|completed query param, returning todos[] and counts{}); POST /api/todos (201 on success, 422 with INVALID_TITLE error envelope on InvalidTitleError); GET /api/todos/:id (200 or 404 TODO_NOT_FOUND); PATCH /api/todos/:id (partial update of title and/or status, mapping status to todo.complete()/todo.reopen(), returning 200/404/422); DELETE /api/todos/:id (204 or 404); DELETE /api/todos?status=completed (bulk delete completed, returns {deletedCount}). All 4xx/5xx must use the error envelope {error, message}. Wire up SQLiteTodoRepository via dependency injection. Run migrations on startup before accepting requests.

tasks.name: rest-api-tests
tasks.description: Write API-level tests for every endpoint per the interface.spec.md TDD Plan (API section). Use an in-memory SQLite database (DATABASE_PATH=:memory:) for test isolation. Required test scenarios: GET /api/todos returns empty list and zero counts when no todos exist; filter=active excludes completed from list but counts reflect all; filter=completed excludes active; invalid filter value returns 400 BAD_REQUEST. POST /api/todos with valid title returns 201 with full resource including UUID id; empty title returns 422 with error=INVALID_TITLE. PATCH /api/todos/:id: status=completed marks active todo completed; status=active reopens; status=completed on already-completed returns 200 (idempotent); unknown id returns 404; invalid title returns 422. DELETE /api/todos/:id: existing todo returns 204; unknown id returns 404. DELETE /api/todos?status=completed: deletes all completed and returns correct deletedCount; zero completed returns 200 with deletedCount=0.

tasks.name: ui-spa
tasks.description: Build the single-page browser application defined in interface.spec.md UI Application Layer section. No full-page reloads after initial load. Required components: Header (title 'todos'); New Todo Input (placeholder 'What needs to be done?', Enter key calls POST /api/todos, clears on success); Todo List (ordered createdAt descending, newest first); Filter Bar (All/Active/Completed tabs, active tab highlighted, client-side filter over todos[]); Footer Bar (visible only when at least one todo exists, showing '{N} item(s) left' active count, filter tabs, and 'Clear completed' button visible only when completedCount > 0); Empty State message when filtered list is empty; Todo Item Component (checkbox toggles status via PATCH, title double-click enters edit mode, delete button visible on hover calls DELETE). Edit mode: input pre-filled with current title, Enter or blur submits PATCH, Escape cancels, empty string submission calls DELETE. State machine: FilterCriteria, editingTodoId, todos[] as source of truth from API. Non-functional: optimistic UI for toggle and delete with rollback on API error; full list loaded on page load; accessibility labels; keyboard navigation; inline API error messages auto-dismissed after 5s.

tasks.name: ui-tests
tasks.description: Write UI tests per interface.spec.md TDD Plan (UI section). Required test scenarios: entering a title and pressing Enter creates a new item at the top of the list; pressing Escape in new-todo input clears without creating; double-clicking a title enters edit mode for only that item; pressing Escape in edit mode restores original title without API call; submitting blank title in edit mode deletes the item; 'Clear completed' button only visible when completedCount > 0; '{N} item(s) left' reflects current active count after toggling; filter tabs correctly show/hide items without an additional network request. Failure modes: API 500 on create leaves input unchanged and shows error; API 500 on toggle reverts checkbox (optimistic rollback); offline state shows error and keeps previously loaded list visible.

events.message:
All 127 tests pass (39 API + 31 UI Playwright + 57 domain/persistence). Every interface.spec.md requirement verified against the codebase with concrete evidence.

API Contract:
- GET /api/todos: todos array + counts object; counts always over ALL todos; filter=all|active|completed (routes.py:109-137); invalid filter->400 (routes.py:117-123).
- POST /api/todos: creates via Todo.create(); 201 with full resource; 422 INVALID_TITLE (routes.py:140-153).
- GET /api/todos/:id: 200 resource or 404 TODO_NOT_FOUND (routes.py:156-165).
- PATCH /api/todos/:id: optional title/status; title->update_title(); completed->todo.complete(); active->todo.reopen(); 200/404/422/400 (routes.py:168-205).
- DELETE /api/todos/:id: 204 no body or 404 (routes.py:208-223).
- DELETE /api/todos?status=completed: 200 with deletedCount (routes.py:226-248).
- Error envelope {error, message} for all 4xx/5xx; 500->INTERNAL_ERROR via generic handler (app.py:98-106).
- Resource fields: id (UUID v4), title, status, createdAt/updatedAt (ISO 8601 UTC via datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()).

UI Application Layer:
- SPA at GET / serving index.html; no full-page reloads.
- Header "todos"; new-todo input placeholder; Enter POSTs, Escape clears, clears on success.
- Todo list ordered newest-first (ORDER BY created_at DESC in SQL; unshift for new items).
- Filter bar: All/Active/Completed tabs; active tab highlighted; client-side filtering (no extra requests).
- Footer: visible only when todos exist; N item(s) left (active count); Clear completed visible only when completedCount>0.
- Empty state message when filtered list is empty.
- Checkbox toggle: PATCH with toggled status; optimistic update with rollback on error.
- Double-click title -> edit mode; Enter/blur saves via PATCH; Escape cancels; empty string -> DELETE.
- Delete button: optimistic remove with rollback on error.
- Clear completed: DELETE /api/todos?status=completed; removes completed from local state.
- Accessibility: labels for checkboxes (label[htmlFor]), aria-label on edit input, aria-live on error container.
- Error display: showError() creates banner with role=alert; setTimeout 5000 auto-dismiss.
- Optimistic UI for toggle and delete; rollback on API error.
- Initial load via loadTodos() -> GET /api/todos.
- Failure modes: 500 on create preserves input; 500 on toggle reverts checkbox; offline shows error and preserves list.

All persistence spec requirements satisfied; 57/57 tests pass.

Schema: 001_create_todos.sql matches spec exactly — todos table with correct
columns/types/constraints, CHECK(status IN ('active','completed')), both
required indexes (idx_todos_status, idx_todos_created_at DESC).

Mapping: save() correctly maps all five domain fields to columns; _row_to_todo()
calls Todo.reconstitute() for event-free reconstitution; TodoTitle re-validates
on read.

Repository contract: find_by_id (returns None, not error, for missing id),
find_all (all/active/completed filters, created_at DESC ordering), save (UPSERT
with created_at excluded from DO UPDATE), delete (silent no-op on missing id),
counts (single aggregate query with COUNT/SUM(CASE)).

Migration strategy: schema_migrations table with version+applied_at, idempotent
runner, version 1 recorded on first apply only.

Connection management: DATABASE_PATH env var → ./todos.db fallback with warning,
PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL, PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000.

Error types: DatabaseInitError on connection failure, PersistenceError wrapping
IntegrityError on save.

Non-functional: raw SQL (no ORM), per-test in-memory DB isolation.
